players.product: filtration, ultra-pure materials handling & deposition materials

quarterly_data.signal: Advanced Purity Solutions (APS) segment net sales fell to $1,799.1 million in 2025, down 3% from $1,850.2 million in 2024, mainly because lower facilities-based semiconductor capital investment reduced demand for fluid handling products and FOUPs, partly offset by higher gas and liquid filtration sales.
quarterly_data.figure: APS net sales $1,799.1 million (2025), down 3% from $1,850.2 million (2024)

quarterly_data.signal: As of December 31, 2025 Entegris had supply purchase obligations of $150.5 million ($88.1 million due within one year), which are non-cancelable commitments including take-or-pay contracts, and capital purchase obligations of $60.0 million ($42.5 million due within one year) for the construction or purchase of property, plant and equipment. Neither was recorded as a liability. No counterparty is named.
quarterly_data.figure: supply purchase obligations $150.5 million; capital purchase obligations $60.0 million (Dec 31, 2025)

contracts.signal: Entegris' 10-K names Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) as a top customer at 16% of net sales in 2025, 16% in 2024 and 11% in 2023; the remaining top ten customers accounted for 34%, 32% and 32%.
